content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Online and campus degree programs for adult learners, tuition-funded with federal aid, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Professional employer organization and insurance services for businesses; no education offering."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Senior living communities and elder care; a different service to different customers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced customer support and technology services sold to enterprises; no education."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Software engineering and IT consulting for enterprise clients; no education."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells recruiting and operations services to one university rather than education to students."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Consulting and managed services for healthcare and corporate clients; education is only a consulting segment."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Accredited post-secondary colleges where students pay tuition for career training, similar to the target's model."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Advertising and marketing agency services for brands; no education delivery."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Online and campus degree and certificate programs for adult learners paying tuition, closely matching the target."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"K-12 virtual schools funded by public districts; different customers and education level."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning commissions from carriers; no education business."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Tuition-based career training and degree programs for adults with federal aid, though focused on technical trades."}]}
